title: Kenyan-Style Meat Stir Fry
description: A flavorful Kenyan-inspired stir fry made with savory meat and snappy vegetables. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the thinly sliced meat and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the pan and set aside.
Add another tablespoon of oil to the pan, then add the sliced onions and cook until they start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the bell peppers and carrots to the pan, cooking until they start to soften, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the cooked meat back into the pan, along with the savory sauce, tomato paste, Kenyan spices, salt, and black pepper. Stir well to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the meat is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot over rice or with some crusty bread.
